script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: Chasing Sunsets

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

A bustling coffee shop, FIONA, a passionate and determined artist in her late 20s, sits at a table, sketching in her notebook. She wears a red scarf and a black turtleneck sweater, her dark curly hair pulled back into a messy ponytail.

BEN, a successful entrepreneur in his late 30s, enters the coffee shop, dressed in a tailored suit and carrying a briefcase. He looks around the room, his gaze settling on Fiona as she continues to work.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

BEN approaches Fiona's table and clears his throat. Fiona looks up, startled, and sets down her sketchbook.

BEN: (smiling) Excuse me, I couldn't help but notice your talent. May I have a look?

Fiona hesitates, but ultimately hands him her sketchbook. Ben flips through the pages, his eyes widening in admiration.

BEN: This is incredible. You have a true gift.

FIONA: (blushing) Thank you. I've been working on it for years.

BEN: I think it's time for you to share your gift with the world. I'd like to help you.

INT. FIONA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Fiona's small apartment is filled with her artwork. Ben sits on the couch, talking to her about his ideas for marketing her work.

FIONA: I've never thought about selling my art. I just create because I love it.

BEN: But think about it, Fiona. Your talent deserves to be seen by more than just a few people in this coffee shop.

FIONA: I don't know if I'm ready for that.

BEN: (leaning forward) I believe in you. And I'll be there every step of the way to help you.

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

Months later, Fiona's artwork is displayed in a prestigious art gallery. Ben stands by her side, beaming with pride as she takes in the scene.

FIONA: (teary-eyed) I can't believe it.

BEN: You deserve this, Fiona. You've worked so hard for it.

FIONA: (looking at Ben) Thank you for believing in me.

BEN: (smiling) It was my pleasure.

INT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

The sun is setting, casting beautiful hues across the sky. Fiona and Ben sit on the edge of a rooftop, watching the sunset.

FIONA: (leaning against Ben) I never thought I'd be here, chasing my dreams.

BEN: (putting his arm around her) And I never thought I'd meet someone as talented and determined as you.

FIONA: (looking at Ben) I'm glad we crossed paths.

They share a moment of silence, watching the sun set, as the city lights begin to twinkle below them.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Fiona stands in front of a large crowd, accepting an award for her artistic achievements. Ben watches her from the audience, filled with pride and admiration.

FIONA: (speaking into the microphone) I couldn't have done it without the support and belief of my loved ones, especially my partner, Ben.

The crowd applauds, and Ben stands, waving proudly as Fiona takes the stage.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Months later, Fiona sits in the same coffee shop, working on a new piece of art. Ben enters, wearing a casual outfit and a wide smile.

BEN: Hi, love. I came to see how my favorite artist is doing.

FIONA: (looks up and smiles) I'm always happy to see you.

They share a moment, sitting together, as Fiona continues to create, knowing that she has a partner who believes in her and supports her every step of the way.

THE END.
